Contact &
kitchen inquiries.

Bored of Toast is currently in active recipe formulation and digital development.

Contact channels in development

Bored of Toast is in an early prototype and recipe drafting stage. Public email inboxes (such as editorial@boredoftoast.com) are not yet live or monitored.

No active inbox during development

To prevent missed messages or unfulfilled inquiries, direct inbox reception is disabled until recipes pass kitchen verification. Public contact channels will open alongside the general release.

Recipe feedback & future kitchen tests

When our testing phase opens for home cooks, we will provide a dedicated web feedback form to submit cooking notes, oven calibration observations, and ingredient swap results.

Press & partnerships

Bored of Toast is independently produced. We do not accept paid product placements or undisclosed sponsored content. Partnership inquiries may be directed to the editorial inbox once it opens.
